relationships.subject: Room CO2 Feedback-Control System - Synthetic Requirements Register
relationships.quote: C4=The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.

relationships.subject: Room CO2 Feedback-Control System - Synthetic Requirements Register
relationships.quote: C4=The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.

facts.statement: The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.
facts.quote: C4=The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.

facts.statement: The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air mass flow using measured room CO2 concentration as feedback.
facts.quote: C5=The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air mass flow using measured room CO2 concentration as feedback.

facts.statement: The occupied-room CO2 concentration shall not exceed 1000 ppm under the design occupancy schedule.
facts.quote: C6=The occupied-room CO2 concentration shall not exceed 1000 ppm under the design occupancy schedule.

facts.statement: The outdoor-air CO2 concentration used by the demonstration model shall be 300 ppm.
facts.quote: C7=The outdoor-air CO2 concentration used by the demonstration model shall be 300 ppm.

facts.statement: CO2 generation shall be proportional to the number of occupants scheduled in the room.
facts.quote: C8=CO2 generation shall be proportional to the number of occupants scheduled in the room.

facts.statement: The controlled room air volume shall be 100 m^3.
facts.quote: C9=The controlled room air volume shall be 100 m^3.

facts.statement: The nominal air density for ventilation mass-flow conversion shall be 1.2 kg/m^3.
facts.quote: C10=The nominal air density for ventilation mass-flow conversion shall be 1.2 kg/m^3.

facts.statement: Each occupant shall contribute 8.18E-6 kg/s of CO2 at the design activity level.
facts.quote: C11=Each occupant shall contribute 8.18E-6 kg/s of CO2 at the design activity level.

facts.statement: The peopleSource implementation shall use a trace-substance concentration parameter of 100 kg/kg and a carrier mass-flow command equal to occupant CO2 generation divided by 100.
facts.quote: C12=The peopleSource implementation shall use a trace-substance concentration parameter of 100 kg/kg and a carrier mass-flow command equal to occupant CO2 generation divided by 100.

facts.statement: The nominal trace-substance concentration used for equation scaling shall be 1.519E-3 kg/kg.
facts.quote: C13=The nominal trace-substance concentration used for equation scaling shall be 1.519E-3 kg/kg.

facts.statement: The fresh-air concentration of 300 ppm shall be represented as 0.3 times the nominal 1000 ppm mass fraction.
facts.quote: C14=The fresh-air concentration of 300 ppm shall be represented as 0.3 times the nominal 1000 ppm mass fraction.

facts.statement: The controller input shall be normalized such that a measured concentration of 1.519E-3 kg/kg produces a normalized value of 1.0.
facts.quote: C15=The controller input shall be normalized such that a measured concentration of 1.519E-3 kg/kg produces a normalized value of 1.0.

facts.statement: The CO2 setpoint presented to the controller shall be 1.0 in normalized concentration units.
facts.quote: C16=The CO2 setpoint presented to the controller shall be 1.0 in normalized concentration units.

facts.statement: The ventilation controller output shall represent an air-change-rate command in ACH.
facts.quote: C17=The ventilation controller output shall represent an air-change-rate command in ACH.

facts.statement: The ventilation command shall be limited to 0.2 through 6.0 ACH during automatic operation.
facts.quote: C18=The ventilation command shall be limited to 0.2 through 6.0 ACH during automatic operation.

facts.statement: The ACH command shall be converted to source mass-flow magnitude using room volume, nominal air density and 3600 s/h.
facts.quote: C19=The ACH command shall be converted to source mass-flow magnitude using room volume, nominal air density and 3600 s/h.

facts.statement: The simulation source component shall use negative mass-flow sign for air entering the room because of the source-port sign convention.
facts.quote: C20=The simulation source component shall use negative mass-flow sign for air entering the room because of the source-port sign convention.

facts.statement: The controller shall use the absolute 1000 ppm room concentration as its compliance limit.
facts.quote: C21=The controller shall use the absolute 1000 ppm room concentration as its compliance limit.

facts.statement: The controller proportional gain shall be 4.0 ACH per normalized concentration error.
facts.quote: C22=The controller proportional gain shall be 4.0 ACH per normalized concentration error.

facts.statement: The controller proportional gain shall be 6.0 ACH per normalized concentration error with an output bias of 3.5 ACH.
facts.quote: C23=The controller proportional gain shall be 6.0 ACH per normalized concentration error with an output bias of 3.5 ACH.

facts.statement: Integral action shall be disabled in the released hackathon reference run to avoid negative windup during long unoccupied periods.
facts.quote: C24=Integral action shall be disabled in the released hackathon reference run to avoid negative windup during long unoccupied periods.

facts.statement: The controller demonstration shall use the approved weekday occupancy schedule with a maximum of 15 occupants.
facts.quote: C25=The controller demonstration shall use the approved weekday occupancy schedule with a maximum of 15 occupants.

facts.statement: The number-of-people signal shall be piecewise constant between defined schedule change times.
facts.quote: C26=The number-of-people signal shall be piecewise constant between defined schedule change times.

facts.statement: The room CO2 measurement shall be represented internally as a Real-valued trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg.
facts.quote: C27=The room CO2 measurement shall be represented internally as a Real-valued trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg.

facts.statement: The controller shall provide a Real-valued ACH command to the airflow conversion gain.
facts.quote: C28=The controller shall provide a Real-valued ACH command to the airflow conversion gain.

facts.statement: The occupancy schedule shall provide an integer-valued people count to the CO2 source calculation.
facts.quote: C29=The occupancy schedule shall provide an integer-valued people count to the CO2 source calculation.

facts.statement: The fresh-air source shall receive both a mass-flow command and a trace-substance concentration parameter.
facts.quote: C30=The fresh-air source shall receive both a mass-flow command and a trace-substance concentration parameter.

facts.statement: If the room CO2 sensor signal is invalid for more than 60 s, the controller shall command 4.0 ACH and raise a sensor-fault indication.
facts.quote: C31=If the room CO2 sensor signal is invalid for more than 60 s, the controller shall command 4.0 ACH and raise a sensor-fault indication.

facts.statement: The 24-hour reference simulation shall log room CO2, outdoor CO2, occupant count, ACH command and physical supply mass flow at 60 s intervals.
facts.quote: C32=The 24-hour reference simulation shall log room CO2, outdoor CO2, occupant count, ACH command and physical supply mass flow at 60 s intervals.

facts.statement: During the approved 24-hour reference run, the maximum room CO2 concentration shall be no greater than 1000 ppm.
facts.quote: C33=During the approved 24-hour reference run, the maximum room CO2 concentration shall be no greater than 1000 ppm.

facts.statement: The conversion between ppm and kg/kg for this benchmark shall use molecular weights 44.01 kg/kmol for CO2 and 28.97 kg/kmol for dry air.
facts.quote: C34=The conversion between ppm and kg/kg for this benchmark shall use molecular weights 44.01 kg/kmol for CO2 and 28.97 kg/kmol for dry air.

facts.statement: The value C={100} kg/kg in the peopleSource shall not be interpreted as the physical room concentration or a realistic gas mixture composition.
facts.quote: C35=The value C={100} kg/kg in the peopleSource shall not be interpreted as the physical room concentration or a realistic gas mixture composition.
